message.content:
The exchange rate between the U.S. dollar (USD) and the British pound (GBP) fluctuates constantly, so the exact amount can vary slightly depending on when you check. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2024), 1 USD is roughly equivalent to **0.78 GBP**.

Using that approximation:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \;\approx\; £15.60
\]

So, **$20 is about £15.60**.  

If you need a precise figure for a specific transaction, it’s best to check a real‑time currency converter (e.g., XE, OANDA, or your bank’s website) at the time of the exchange.
